title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; update docs site
author: Ava Patel
description: Motivation: provide first-class, opinionated RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts to help teams get started quickly with retrieval-augmented generation and structured tool integrations. This PR adds example templates, a step-by-step quickstart, tool-calling examples, and corresponding docs site updates so the content is discoverable from the Guides nav. What changed: - examples/rag/: new quickstarts, example scripts, and agent templates (YAML + minimal Python/TS driver examples) - docs/guides/rag.md: guide that explains design decisions, recommended prompt structure, caching/TTL guidance, and cost/perf tradeoffs - docs/guides/agents/tool-calling.md: documented tool contract, example tool adapters, and best practices for safety & validation - website/data/navigation.yml: added nav entry under Guides -> Agents & RAG - small assets: diagram SVG and example dataset (small) High-level checklist: - [x] Add RAG agent templates (YAML) - [x] Add Python and TypeScript quickstart drivers - [x] Add docs pages and link from Guides nav - [x] Add simple tool-calling example (external API + dummy tool) - [x] Run docs site build and smoke tests Notes: templates are intentionally minimal and annotated; they demonstrate K/V cache configuration, chunking/embedding settings, and a recommended re-ranking stage. Quickstart includes instructions for both Hosted API and local dev with the redwood-local runtime. See linked commits for more detail.
